A '''blessing''' is an enchanted book crafted from a [[Hell-Bound Book]] and a set of themed ingredients. Blessings are the main way to get [[enchantment]]s in [[Matcha Flavoured]], replacing the enchanting table. Each one stores a fixed set of enchantments at fixed levels and is named, in its tooltip, as a prayer or elegy to a deity or mythological figure: the [[Prayer of Prometheus]] grants Unbreaking, the [[Elegy of Icarus]] grants Feather Falling.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
Every blessing is a shaped [[Crafting Table|crafting]] recipe with a Hell-Bound Book in the center slot. The surrounding slots (up to eight) hold ingredients tied to the enchantment and the figure it is named after. The recipes are in the pack's <code>recipe/blessing</code> folder.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/prometheus.json}}</ref> Crafting a Hell-Bound Book unlocks all 23 blessing recipes; since 1.12.9 the "Unholy Knowledge" advancement for that craft unlocks them as well.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/hell_bound_book.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/hell/craft_hell_bound_book.json}}</ref>

{{Data/Blessings}}

The Prayer of Daedalus and the Prayer of Lu Ban need an [[amalgamated pith]], and the Prayer of Prometheus needs [[pith]], which makes Unbreaking, Efficiency and Mending the most expensive enchantments to craft. {{MCW|Protection}} and {{MCW|Sharpness}} have no blessing at all and come only from [[Ofuda]], loot or [[Adamant equipment|adamant equipment]].

== Usage ==
A blessing is combined with a piece of equipment in an [[anvil]], like any {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Blessings do not stack. Because the pack sets the anvil cost multiplier of every vanilla enchantment to 1 (and of most of its own to 0) and gives the player 10,000 experience levels when they use an anvil, applying a blessing is cheap; see [[Enchanting#Applying enchantments]].

=== Old enchantment ids ===
All blessings store the pack's enchantments under their current <code>matcha</code> ids. Before 1.12.3, five blessings (the [[Prayer of Aeolus]], [[Prayer of Demeter]], [[Prayer of St. Clement]], [[Prayer of Will]] and [[Elegy of Hyacinthus]]) stored the ids from before the move to that namespace, which the pack converted when the item was worn or held. The pack keeps those old enchantments in a <code>main</code> namespace only to update items from earlier versions.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/will.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/main/README.txt}}</ref>

Blessings are not the Hell-Bound Book itself: the crafted book stores only the blessing's enchantments, not the Curse of Binding that a blank Hell-Bound Book carries.

== Appearance ==
All blessings share the item name "Blessing". The prayer or elegy name is shown as a dark gray lore line, and each blessing has its own texture.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref> The Prayer of Man and the Prayer of Talos have rare (aqua) rarity and the Prayer of Lu Ban has epic (purple) rarity; the others use the default rarity of an enchanted book.

The three elegies are named after tragic figures of Greek myth (Arachne, Hyacinthus and Icarus), while the prayers address gods, Titans, heroes and saints.
